```python
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

# Assessment attempt binding details
binding = {
    "assessment": "Final Exam",
    "course": "CS101",
    "student_name": "Alice Johnson",
    "student_id": "S12345",
    "attempt": "Attempt 1",
    "bound_at": datetime(2026, 10, 11).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
    "status": "Bound"
}

print("Binding Details:")
display(binding_df.T.rename(columns={0: "Value"}))

# Save the binding record
binding_df.to_csv("assessment_attempt_binding.csv", index=False)
print("\n✔ Binding record saved to 'assessment_attempt_binding.csv'")
```
